title: DXF writer-setup vector handoff moves
scope: Remove redundant writer-state deep copies for locally prepared export metadata vectors, including regenerated CLASS records.
Preserve existing const-reference setters and source dx_data collections.

sourceChange.before: fileExport assembled local CLASS, BLOCK_RECORD, canonical LTYPE, raw-section, named-dictionary, and root-dictionary vectors, then passed each to a const-reference setter that deep-copied the vector into dxfRW.
sourceChange.after: Rvalue-reference setter overloads move those six local vectors into dxfRW; all existing const-reference overloads remain unchanged for copy semantics.
sourceChange.effect: Eliminates one setup-handoff deep copy per vector. Source dx_data collections remain unchanged. The isolated raw-section working copy remains necessary because optional AcDs projection may append a section.

validation.diffCheck: scoped git diff --check passed for src/libdxfrw.h, dwg2dxf/dx_iface.cpp, DWG_DXF_OPEN_SOURCE_PARITY_PLAN.md, and this receipt

assessment.planImpact: Removes redundant deep copies of six prepared writer-setup vectors while retaining source isolation, raw-section validation, and all existing limits.

testsRun: Strict dwg2dxf and adapter-test target build
Focused raw DXF section capture-limit and end-to-end passthrough CTests
Focused ASCII/binary BLOCK_RECORD owner CLI tests
Focused canonical LTYPE, CLASS metadata, and named-dictionary adapter tests
method.limitations: The change removes one deep copy for each listed setup vector. It does not measure process RSS or allocator metadata, eliminate the raw-section source-isolation working copy, or claim complete semantic preservation for any associated object family.
